Newer version of Water Sentinel WSG-3 is NOT the  same as the previous version. The new version does not include an integrated O-ring and the guide threads are not continuous, but have a gap between the start point and the endpoint of the threads. This results in less friction needed to keep the water filter in place. Also the two small tabs in the inside top of the water filter that depress the switch which allows water to flow into the filter must be of a different size or in a different position. The new version does not depress the switch far enough to cause water to flow. Suggest purchasing the original GE version or, if you have good water in your area, purchase the filter bypass cap appropriate for your refrigerator.
